shortDescription: Stable (STABLE) is set to unlock approximately 888.89 million tokens, worth about $23.32 million, at 1:00 PM (UTC+8) on November 8. According to ChainCatcher, the figures are based on token unlock data from Web3 asset data platform RootData.
